name: Magic of the Smith (Thaumaturgy: Path of Conjuring, Intermediate)

system.description: You can summon forth complex objects with moveable parts (handguns, CD players, anything within the limits of size) with the expenditure of two Willpower Traits. You must have a working knowledge (Storyteller's discretion) of the object. The object remains for 10 minutes for every Willpower Trait expended. Permanency will not affect objects conjured with this power.
